results.plan_rationale: First retrieve the list of available Tamil voices (including female options) with get_voice_library. Then synthesize the Tamil announcement text (file A) using a female Tamil voice selected from the previous step's output.

results.name: Multi-Page Document OCR

results.plan_rationale: The user wants to extract all text and any Markdown tables from the PDF file 'legal_circular.pdf'. Using the ocr_document tool on the provided PDF (identified by ID A) will return the full document content in Markdown format, preserving tables. No prior steps are required.

results.name: Single Image Table OCR
results.task: Extract the worksheet table from receipt_table.png into clean Markdown.
results.plan_rationale: The user wants to extract the worksheet table from the image receipt_table.png and present it as clean Markdown. The appropriate tool is ocr_page, which extracts Markdown text and pipe tables from a single image. We reference the image by its assigned ID "A" (per constraint C4) and no prior steps are needed.

results.name: Full End-to-End Pipeline (OCR -> Translate -> TTS)
results.task: Extract text from annual_report.pdf, translate it into Marathi, and create an audio summary.
results.plan_rationale: Step s1 extracts the full text from the provided PDF (ID A) using OCR. Step s2 translates the extracted English text into Marathi while preserving any Markdown structure. Step s3 converts the Marathi translation into spoken audio using a default Marathi voice. The steps are ordered to satisfy data dependencies.
